[url=https://twitter.com/farmfolksgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/beefa381162677cb2bb0518e0a7a260f0daceb9b.png[/img][/url]

Thank you,
- Crytivo Team

notes.title: The Dynamics of Relationships in Farm Folks
notes.content:
Hello, folks!

The Crytivo team is sending you our warmest wishes this Valentine's Day.

We're here to flood your world with smiles and a tsunami of positivity! May this Valentine's Day not only warm your heart but also spark the joy of companionship, even if it means finding someone who laughs when you forget to water the plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/53ec48d8376b8d8927b3c6dcfdc997bc837602c0.png[/img]

[h1]Diving Deeper into Relationships in Farm Folks
[/h1]
This moment is perfect to dive deeper into what sets Farm Folks apart from just another day of farming. Our game is bursting with diverse systems like Construction, Automation, Farming, Ranching, Survival, Character Leveling, and even Combat. We're keen to explore these in detail soon, but today, let's focus on the heart of our game: the Characters (NPCs).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/466be67a72f465056bf7d9bb428420e72989b2ac.png[/img]

[h1]Characters
[/h1]
Navigating relationships with these characters requires thoughtful choices. Every action and decision you make influences how characters perceive and react to you. They're not static; their preferences, likes, and dislikes significantly impact your journey. Neglect them, and you might find merchants spiking their prices, or residents giving you the cold shoulder.

Each character brings a unique personality and backstory to life. Discover what makes them tick through conversations and quest completions. How you dress and present yourself also matters, affecting their reactions through stats like Impression and Practicality. (We'll delve into these attributes in upcoming blogs; don't forget to sign up to our news updates)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a79ad67ac4c30d9b61ea5c0777c81f9b706f5f98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/88e3052484bfb65b77d8a9db3d2a2e43702ee4c1.png[/img]


We're developing a clothing stat system responsible for clothing [b]Impressions[/b] and [b]Practicality. [/b]Some outfits will look stunning but be totally impractical to work on the farm, and others, like jeans, will have high practicality and medium impression, allowing you to get dirty in style. For example, a stunning dress that earns you compliments but gets dirty from farm work might lead to negative emotions and block communication. This system ensures that your fashion choices have real gameplay implications and depth.


But there's more to our characters (NPCs) than meets the eye. They adapt to the changing seasons and their mood swings, changing their clothing and even their hairstyles! Watching the residents of Farm Folks evolve in such ways brings a new layer of depth and realism to our world.


Below, you can find some character designs from the Farm Folks. We will talk about every individual in our future updates:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/0575ef2af0578bdc8e980696878d3fed7022f491.png[/img]

Relationship Dynamics

In Farm Folks, you'll navigate a range of possible relationships with the characters: Marriage, friendship, rivalry, and potentially more. Each relationship status offers unique interactions and outcomes, adding layers of complexity to your gameplay experience.



[h1]In-game social network Buzzila
[/h1]

Buzzila, our in-game social network, is your gateway to staying updated with the evolving relationships and events. It's filled with intriguing tidbits, from winning over characters to learning about their quirks. Stay tuned for more details in our future blogs and consider subscribing to our emails for the latest updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/773034331ab49dd9409b8d7a742f29a13994a35d.png[/img]

Close Relationships

Forming deeper bonds allows you to find a life partner and even get married. Coexistence demands understanding each other's living needs, reflected in our system that appreciates the significance of rooms and decorations. (Expect more on this in future discussions.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/aa23a7a9cec352bea578d1671b5c137d2c961199.png[/img]

Imagine needing to create a mansion that caters to your partner’s unique tastes—maybe they desire pink wallpapers and Baroque-style furniture, or perhaps they won’t settle for less than two refrigerators in the kitchen. And about that Mercedes mention? While it sounds like we’re pitching an ad, rest assured, it’s all in good fun - no luxury cars or real ads yet!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/bc53da48f09f866ea56e2d974cafabda137b772b.png[/img] 

After committing to a character, you're given time, like half an in-game year, to fulfill their living standards. Failure to do so signals a lack of commitment, risking the relationship. Success, however, means inviting your partner into your life on the farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/baf3affc158836fd902db16cc9dcae4f59841fcd.png[/img]

And if one partner isn’t enough, why not explore connections with multiple characters? Balancing their needs adds a layer of strategy and depth to your Farm Folks story.


Would you like to see children in the game? Let us know if adding nurseries or children’s rooms sounds like a charming update!

[h1]
Player Relationships[/h1]

And there's more! Beyond NPC interactions, we're opening the doors to romantic ventures with other players. Imagine going on dates, exchanging gifts, and possibly walking down the aisle together.

What’s more romantic than carrying your partner or sharing a mount for a sunset ride? Your feedback is crucial—share your dreams and ideas for what love and life in Farm Folks could be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/de9ccbf119a372fdc0fe26f7a4b3db282a9aa256.png[/img]
[h1]
Follow us on Kickstarter[/h1]

Get ready for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign for Farm Folks! Secure exclusive rewards and gain early access to unique features by supporting us. Be part of shaping the future of Farm Folks and join our community of pioneers. Click the button below to get notified and stay updated!

[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/de5fdd3fbf17d7044144a74eadcc676a6356d73c.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7f21c32aa1da35ccc664bd839c4b95840c27c25c.png[/img]
[/url]
We eagerly await your comments and suggestions. What other features would you love to see in Farm Folks?

notes.title: Farm Folks Devlog #8 Kickstarter Update, Latest NPCs, Automation, and more!
notes.content:
Hello Farm Folks!


We’re excited to share with you our latest devlog. In this update, we would like to chat more about our upcoming Kickstarter and the exciting new features we're implementing into the game.


[h1]Kickstarter[/h1]

As you know, you - our incredible community - have been asking us to launch on Kickstarter. Well, we’re hard at work on crafting more than just the Kickstarter campaign page, but also an official gameplay trailer for Farm Folks! This trailer will showcase all aspects of the game: [b]farming, construction, automation, NPC interactions, machinery, animals[/b], and various means of transportation. We’re proud to say that the entirety of the trailer is shot within the game. We have no plans to use CGI outside of Unity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/56d3c3a7d9009bb06b38df581de2adf992e015a6.jpg[/img]

The gameplay trailer itself is a massive undertaking for our smaller team, but we know that it will be well worth it (we think you’ll love it)! At the same time, we are continuously developing game features and assets. It’s certainly a juggle of challenging tasks, but we’re making fruitful progress behind the scenes; some of our folks in Legendairy have seen only a fraction of what’s to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8161ecdfc4e5dee219204b0c28825be801ac31e8.jpg[/img]

While our initial hope was to launch the Kickstarter towards the beginning of 2023, our scope ultimately requires more work and attention to detail. With that said, it probably comes as no surprise that we are pushing the Kickstarter launch further as we continue to craft the campaign. We see your eagerness across our channels and feel the love and support of the community; Crytivo is a small but strong team that is fully invested in seeing Farm Folks become the success you all believe it can be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fe220063b007a986dce17a67229f483556af36e3.jpg[/img]

Though it may take a little longer for us to hit that Kickstarter launch button, we do want to introduce some Stretch Goals ahead of the Kickstarter. These Stretch Goals will help us evaluate new features and introduce them to the game based on our community preferences. Let’s call them Farm Folks Community Stretch Goals. We will reveal new goals if and when we reach the current one(s). Of course, you can influence our future picks by leaving your comments and suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks]Discord[/url]. 


Please [url=https://discord.com/channels/274283563367792643/949448944117751879/1058429126144426104]check our updated FAQ section[/url] to get your questions answered regarding Kickstarter.


[h1]Farm Folks Community Stretch Goals[/h1]


[h2]5000 Kickstarter Followers Stretch Goal[/h2]
[h2]Unlocks Console Release![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/eb932f59c45ecb4bec62dce3ce70db349ea6d3aa.jpg[/img]

First and foremost, our plan is to release Farm Folks for Steam on Windows. Help us reach [b]5000 followers[/b] on our Kickstarter [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0]promo page[/url] to unlock console support for PlayStation and Xbox! The Nintendo Switch console will be introduced as its own goal during the Kickstarter campaign. This decision is meant to account for Switch hardware limitations. If we achieve this goal in the future, our team will need to hire dedicated developers to help us port the game.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4944ac5746d834456d8265577ba44aa44751e50e.jpg[/img][/url]

To contribute, press "Notify Me On Launch"


[h2]25000 Twitter Followers[/h2]
[h2]Unlocks Gardener Accessories[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f7620fbde8041f4ae38d539246489edd154a5c69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/96d02e05d62886a798e1c9d8dfaa2f063b35e076.png[/img]

With 25,000 Farm Folks Twitter followers, we will create a set of character-gardener customizations. This fancy set will include a backpack, gloves, and belt.

[url=https://twitter.com/farmfolksgame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a0cffcaac637b5c0c5555496e0bf5535d3b61217.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]7500 Members on Discord[/h2]
[h2]Backpack with the Plush Cat inside[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9e5de52c59970674898526a82a3251b87ad2af13.png[/img]

You'll never be alone when you're farming and exploring the world of Farm Folks with our Plush Cat Backpack!


[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/df570e8b166c49b733f1b1a9105300c5621350cc.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]You can track Stretch Goal Progress on our Discord[/h3]

[url=https://discord.com/channels/274283563367792643/1111751915919913030/1111765853617279108][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5510322c4d4f3ddc129cd35ce17b77691eee63f9.jpg[/img][/url]


And by the way, Unicow is going to be back on Kickstarter! We know how much you love Unicorn Cow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2de740c5262394653ec2f0617727433a5654ea75.jpg[/img]

[h1]Game Updates[/h1]

[h2]NPCs[/h2]

We’re continuing to develop concepts and backstories for our town folks. These NPCs will be assigned routine life habits and have their own stories to share. Say hello to some of the newer romanceable folks from town:


[h2]Meet Ài [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2601331a21d0a45a57b2af2208dd306781667a21.jpg[/img]

Need fashion advice or expert help when shopping for a new pair of fancy shorts? Meet Ài, a romanceable NPC, who is ready to assist you!


[h2]Meet Avril[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f5059a434b06d44ada7712e7b371b5ce8f20b40b.jpg[/img]
Avril is a lead vocalist in a local band. She has dreams to fulfill, and she is working hard towards achieving them with or without your help. This fire-haired superstar is sure to rock your world.


[h2]Meet Micha 
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cc8936eb7fc54d910d157e9a5841cb94087203ea.jpg[/img]
Micha might give people the cold shoulder at first, but she’ll warm up to you if you share her love of nature and passion for protecting the environment. 


[h2]Meet Mike[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d06641bebd9a372fccb2ad91a5f315bc7171e405.jpg[/img]
As the owner of the hoverboard shop in town, Mike's success isn't something he brags about. 

He's a humble entrepreneur who may be looking for a partner to ride alongside for life.


[h2]Meet Emre[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2e69748ad165e69de65d9098018097e90397c0fb.jpg[/img]
Emre is the resident expert on all things birds! You can often catch him birdwatching and sporting his signature quirky style.


[h2]Meet Willie [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/61feb941454645b5801fa233983c1549e9bcde2a.jpg[/img]
Willie is a dedicated lifeguard on a luxurious yacht docked at the island. With a keen eye for detail and years of experience, he takes pride in ensuring the safety of all passengers.


[h1]Character Dialogue Screen[/h1]

notes.title: Introducing Farm Folks | DINO CRISIS MODE
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing an Unbelievable New Update to Farm Folks

[/h1]Greetings, dear farmers! We know that you've been enjoying the serene and peaceful life in the world of Farm Folks. But now, we have a thrilling surprise for you! Get ready to embark on an adventure of prehistoric proportions with our latest game mode, [b][i]Farm Folks: Dino Crisis Mode![/i][/b]

[b][h1]FARM FOLKS | DINO CRISIS MODE[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b7421b53c6deccb109435bd0e56162d949454630.jpg[/img]

That's right, folks! It's time to trade in your pitchforks for laser-guided weapons and saddle up on your very own combat dinosaurs. Gone are the days of just tending to your crops and livestock. In Dino Crisis Mode, your tranquil farm will transform into a battleground where you'll tame, feed, play catch with and customize dinosaurs, decking them out with weapons, stickers, and maybe even a stylish fedora or two for epic dino duels against fellow players. Can you imagine a T-Rex wearing a tutu? We can, and it's hilarious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/bd21f930907cc9f49cd9f89981d951ad1d5e8682.jpg[/img]

While you can still enjoy the tranquil life of farming, a thrilling twist awaits you. When the time comes, you and your combat-ready dinosaurs will be dropped onto the mysterious Skull Island. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5b1f387fb1f767fb3927ad179bbc5548e6e47a46.jpg[/img]

Skull Island spans an impressive 36 km², a mysterious and vast landscape waiting to be explored. As a player, you'll be dropped onto the island alongside your battle dinosaur. In the initial moments, you must locate your dino companion, perhaps hidden amongst the lush foliage, and begin looting the surroundings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6bb6fe002a04a9829d655871433c6a71a2073e0a.jpg[/img]

Here, players can team up for groundbreaking Dino Crisis Mode battles that can last for days, or even weeks, of non-stop, adrenaline-pumping gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2901dc5329de218fcad09e09aaa6c7ad043f8e33.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]This persistent island has the capacity to hold up to 600 players simultaneously, creating a dynamic and unpredictable environment. [/b][/h1]

Our tests have revealed that not all players exhibit hostility at first; however, we recommend exercising caution and not placing trust in anyone, as alliances may shift quicker than a raptor's reflexes. After all, as they say in the prehistoric world, "keep your friends close, and your dinos closer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/19d6373ab49ca22887c7585831d879db5781b564.png[/img]

As your loyal dinosaur companions grow exhausted from the intense combat, you'll gain a truly unforgettable experience. With every thunderous step these giants take, the world around you will ignite in flames and become littered with bullet casings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/ad2f8b5b355d7051f4f8df8ca4af3d3a50619247.gif[/img]

And, for a bit of fun, our developers have added a small chance for your dino to let out a cheeky fart, leaving your opponents in a fit of laughter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/ebd96fcf90c685c7f523ba31544ac74bc65fd807.jpg[/img]

Once the dust settles and the battles subside, you and your dinosaur best friend can return home to your peaceful farm. Your mighty dino will then switch gears, assisting you with heavy farming tasks and helping you manage your daily routine. Don't be surprised if you find your dino sunbathing in a kiddie pool, wearing sunglasses, and sipping on a fruit smoothie after a hard day's work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/794c2643520126e4f146b2c9f893bd89e13ff118.jpg[/img]

But how do you get these amazing dinosaurs? As you venture into the wild to find or steal dino eggs, you might come across a particularly sneaky and amusing way to acquire a new dino companion. That's right, you'll have the opportunity to steal a dino egg from another unsuspecting player! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/71de92a5f0185d8c211851265f83fe0c8a337ce0.jpg[/img]

Imagine the hilarity that ensues as you carefully plot your daring heist. Disguise yourself as a friendly, fellow farmer, offer to lend a helping hand, and then, when the moment is right, snatch the precious dino egg right out from under their nose! But be careful not to get caught, or you'll be chased by a pack of angry dinos, leaving you and your stolen egg scrambling for safety.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/397eee30993caa71c0f9c4d30322030585b7c1ec.jpg[/img]

Each dinosaur will have unique color and skin patterns — no two animals will be the same. Their characteristics and behaviors will also differ, ranging from playful to grumpy or combative. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/94a7effff1d4801f8405e2594c6306be052e5746.jpg[/img]

To achieve this level of diversity and detail, dinosaur skins are procedurally generated by our advanced Open AI, SkinGPT. This innovative system utilizes online information available up to the year 2021 related to dinosaurs and converts that information into high-resolution dinosaur skins, creating truly one-of-a-kind creatures for players to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cbe4ab39db25344a316749ab0e1d5b3febfed865.jpg[/img]

We are committed to making SkinGPT available for free (non-profit). However, if Microsoft decides to buy it for 20 billion dollars, we might have to charge it to a $20 per month subscription fee. But for now, our focus is on providing an amazing experience for all players to enjoy our unique and diverse dinosaurs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/13bcdfd088766fd26715397bf0e3a6a9246a23ee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/38efdc3803b1638ce6b10a84cae1cb4f90994c6c.jpg[/img]

With three distinct dino classes — fast, tactical, and heavy — each with unique perks and weapon-carrying abilities, you'll have endless ways to dominate the battlefield. Need to get somewhere quickly? Hop on a pterodactyl and glide through the skies like a boss, leaving a trail of crop-dusting chaos behind you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/41f1a9cee4f5726a41a7e581130c1424ae71f00f.jpg[/img]

Players can craft weapons on their farms or loot them from defeated rivals on the battlefield. These weapons come with extensive customization options, allowing you to paint them in different colors and even add custom decals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5c10e095e6976c4ea96069e9d1fb56d44ff5bc51.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e8572086a166f115b1534d0110429675c298f098.png[/img]

Each weapon has unique characteristics, introducing diversity to the combat experience. Rare weapons can be discovered in crates scattered throughout Skull Island or unlocked by completing quests for NPCs in the Farm Folks world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6dcbf1b52063d9b610f3fbad0139299faa3a4739.jpg[/img]

But wait, there's more! We're also introducing a revolutionary voice command system that utilizes your microphone. It allows you to motivate and inspire your dinos during battles with phrases like "Let's go, boy, show them what we can do!" or "Bite his a$$ off!" Train them with new phrases and watch how they react. Don't be shocked if your dino responds with an eye roll or a sarcastic snort — these dinos have a sense of humor too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8b5ebd40890851fa10beeaf40d15676ca6bd49c5.jpg[/img]

So, what are you waiting for? Get ready to rule the farm and the battlefield with your mighty dino army in Farm Folks: Dino Crisis Mode! And remember, this is all just an April Fools' joke — don't forget to have a good laugh with your friends and fellow farmers! Embrace the playful concept of Farm Folks: Dino Crisis Mode and share in the excitement of this prehistoric twist on your favorite farming game. Enjoy the best of both worlds, from peaceful farming to action-packed dinosaur battles sprinkled with humor, as you create unforgettable memories with your trusty dino companions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/3c32e89a5e79fdf800b96365b109987e1c7e33b0.gif[/img]

Did you know that we plan to launch a Kickstarter campaign for Farm Folks soon? We need your help to create an unforgettable experience for everyone! Click 'Get Notified' for our Kickstarter launch on the Farm Folks page. Your support will make a significant difference during our launch.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fd4332b6e8277339bb3a4e9e69d919b2675991d3.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/426abbbb55d1f3f4ee9e9f25ddaef5c7760d4680.png[/img][/url]

End before you go, don't forget to Wishlist Farm Folks on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/895160/Farm_Folks/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9cfc5a3d63f5300c6c1898750783a54a1c3b7b51.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b3a2f410ef8c3ee4e75a8cdee075c459317fa1ee.png[/img]

Shelves are also customizable! There are up to 3 different colors that can be applied to your shelves. You can choose different styles, play with sizing, and pick different handles. All shelves start off empty and can be filled with our “clutter,” just the way you want it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a44d93a38b0d16e25e79de63c8eb55e68978baa4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7aa302b9e787331d62dc6cc29f54ccbd4798e301.png[/img]

[b]Fishing Rod[/b]
Fishing rods will have different levels in Farm Folks. Higher-level fishing rods will allow you to catch bigger fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8acec88695ca466de1de30a9e2bef2305de1206d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1b46cb0d800af9a217b476b805076505e0a40a52.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d599faa495546408d8056b13f7d238f6a9d701cc.png[/img]

[b]Lamps[/b]
We’ve designed more light fixtures! Our light fixtures utilize our adaptive design function, meaning fixtures will adapt to the surface you’re pointing your cursor towards. For example, if you choose to place a lamp and point your cursor to the wall, it will automatically change and become a wall lamp! Move your cursor up toward the ceiling and it will adapt and become a ceiling lamp fixture. The same will happen if you look at the floor or a shelf.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8614ce5a952b3c6b0aac64c4d551c63457481182.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/575e7fc6da0480e9aeb44cada1e6553a8cbeb2b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/57ab8f815565ffc4d3f1cfdae49fa37a7e01a11a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/60517c387348e533d6d5e780b2e415142122bf7d.png[/img]

What is also cool about these lamps is that you can choose different shades for almost any lamp pole design. You can select your pattern and color for all elements of the lamp.

[b]Coffee Tables[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/14844196cb3a0c146172d789318a96a55d5e256b.png[/img]

TVs
TVs will deliver important information to you, the player. These broadcasts will include things like Weather Forecasts, Local Festivals, Contest Schedules, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5d754fe3c76b5c6d62effcbc32ae20837590afe1.png[/img]

[b]Grandfather Clock[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4941bc0c2c5975614f2aba8c29dc2fa93ff1eaf6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a1430a4cb0d1f2a1444086d49a947b7927707b67.png[/img]

[b]Color Mixer Station[/b]
Our Color Mixer Station is specially designed to help you extract colors from berries scattered around the island. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/483510bc3a8ca92719df0f28263cf9aad872df50.png[/img]

Gather different colored berries and mix them into a jar to yield a unique color. Attach it to your spray gun and you’re good to go! This system will allow us to control coloring options at the beginning of the game for new players. You’ll be able to make any color you want as you progress and unlock new locations with new berries. The UI is still in development, but you’ll get to see it soon. If you don’t want to miss it, please join our Discord or join our emailing list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b676d3ff1152b311daf1b629c00c7270fb6ec0b3.png[/img]

NEXT UP: FARMING

There are multiple disciplines in this task that include ground tilling, seeds planting/throwing, crop growth mechanics, watering, etc.

[list]
[*] We’re working on basic farming mechanics first. It will allow you to plant, water, and harvest crops. In our future updates, we will add a system that will support dynamic fruit or veggie spawning. Based on the set of parameters that you’ll need to meet, you’ll be able to increase or lower the yield of the crop.  
[*] Watering is another beast of the system. We’ve already implemented water containers and are now working on polishing the system overall. It needs to be intuitive and easy to use.
[*] Electricity generation and transmission. Solar panels and windmills will generate electricity for your farm and, by placing electric poles, you’ll be able to deliver electricity to devices or structures that require it.
[*] Basic character stats: 
[list]
[*] Fatigue will make your character less efficient and you’ll need to sleep to recover. You can, however, still skip a few nights of sleep if you have things to do since the game doesn’t have a Forceful Night's Sleep mechanic. 
 [*] Character Experience. Your character will acquire experience as a farmer or a builder as your tasks correspond to skill actions. Mechanics, structures, and crops will unlock based on your character's experience.
[*] Clothing Stats that include Impression and Practicality. We will talk about this in the future.
[/list]
[*] Resource mining and resource delivery system. 
[*] Expansion of the construction system, including new construction blocks and new materials. 
[*] User Experience improvements.
[*] Flooring.
[*] Wall painting.
[*] Character creation and customization.
[*] Basic NPC interactions.
[*] Quest system expansion.
[*] Co-op optimizations.
[/list]

Thank you everyone, and don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks]Discord Server Here [/url]

-Crytivo Crew

notes.title: Animals, Animations, Machinery, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Kickstarter Announcement[/h1]
It's official! We're launching a Kickstarter! Many members of our community have been asking for ways to back [i]Farm Folks[/i] and/or reserve their copy of the game early. The idea of launching a Kickstarter campaign has been something we’ve seen from fans - old and new. So, after running a couple community polls, we realized that the demand was high enough to launch a campaign that can lead to a more expansive game than any of us initially dreamed.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6159271b985536d54ddfc8f27ea62c8b9c4f11ac.jpg[/img][/url]

You can follow the Kickstarter pre-launch page [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0]here[/url]. Be sure to help spread the word as we'll have plenty of amazing rewards in store for backers! And don't worry, if you had previously backed the game with the original dev team, you will still receive your tier rewards [i]or[/i] you can select a new tier equivalent for shiny new goodies from the new Kickstarter. Read our Kickstarter FAQ [url=https://discord.com/invite/farmfolks]here[/url].

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crytivogames/farm-folks-0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a950d6af5c8476dce1d2afe1d47191491ec0ca95.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Now, let's get into Part 2 of Devlog #5.[/h3]

[h1]Resources and Materials[/h1]
To build the farm of your dreams, you’ll need a number of resources and materials. Lucky for you, we've been working on exactly that! You’ll find an abundance of useful resources scattered around the island with multiple ways of acquiring said materials. Initially, you’ll need to craft tools such as pickaxes or an axe. Using these tools, start mining, chopping trees, or even cracking rocks beneath your feet. Since [i]Farm Folks[/i] takes place in a near future, we will be able to introduce technology that you can only dream of in our current time.

[h3]Copper Ore[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/00563266ea0322b028e1b97cf01e1f61eb6d460d.png[/img]

[h3]Iron Ore[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/98ac7ffe3532c1b6292f139f1dc42d82c365bd37.png[/img]

[h3]Stone[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/983b31d4fa5573a3bafa1889d6c65b61d65caf43.png[/img]

[h3]Quartz[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4c072f2935bc7873176c1a89a0506c88c0b9a4e0.png[/img]

Don't worry. You won't have to collect resources by hand for too long as we'll incorporate [b]Automatization[/b] options for these routine tasks. You'll simply be able to install [b]Resource Extractor Stations[/b] that will mine resources from the installation spots - automagically! 

[h1]Automatization[/h1]

There are several farming life sim games being released on what seems to be a daily basis. With [i]Farm Folks[/i], we really wanted to be innovative and bring something new to the genre. Something unique. In our quest to do so, we decided to merge game mechanics from your favorite videogames that naturally fit into our [i]Farm Folks[/i] vision. We chose to give you detailed construction and customization options with a level of detail never before seen in farming sims. 

[list]
[*] [b]Customization and construction[/b] systems inspired by [i]The Sims[/i], [i]Raft[/i], [i]Valheim[/i] games, and [i]Animal Crossing[/i].
[*] [b]Automatization and resource management[/b] systems inspired by[i] Factorio[/i] and [i]Satisfactory[/i].
[*] [b]Life simulation and farming[/b] inspired by [i]Stardew Valley[/i], [i]My Time at Portia[/i], and [i]Farm Together[/i].
[/list]

[h1]Stations[/h1]

[b]Miner[/b]
This machine mines natural resources for your convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/97fc583d19c48d3e819fbab665feb1f505d1642b.png[/img]

[b]Organic 3D Printer[/b] (Extractor. Concept and model still in production)
A 3D printer that produces animal products such as meat, wool, and milk by scanning animal DNA. Love steak? No need to harm any of your animal friends!

[b]Packager[/b]
Combine individual farm products into a neat looking package. Packages can be customized to match your desired farm brand. You can even choose your colors and add a customizable farm name on it. Some NPCs will require only packaged products later in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/498877e1e526b130c8effafc422ffeb9d1ea1e27.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4144196ef79b82235d301d39c9fcd13cd755eb6d.png[/img]

Examples of Animal Products and Packaging:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/27bf622644e8187f2613c6a7801ec0c5e08f0c3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/33f45be99b9e377eaf3cbe89dbe29213b23e14b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d0bcdb7f8bea25917e914b5367f90774eb17b029.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2b0d9594df1fb13d7e3407c6354d0a3f16587603.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/3fed612e888f53d69721728a2b61d199fb9ad1a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/ae64e8b848f71f2bbcf48e9bea7d2f5851269a03.png[/img]

[b]Mixer[/b]
This station mixes things - duh! Mix multiple products to create something new and exciting! For example, mix [b]Sugar[/b], [b]Flour[/b], and [b]Salt[/b] to yield [b]Dough[/b]. Send it to the [b]Cooker[/b] with some berries to start a berry pie production. In [i]Farm Folks[/i], you’re not only able to make products in single quantities, but you’ll be able to set up mass productions. The entire island may come to rely on your production of food and other farming products. We think doing so will be a lot of fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5270997d6405646f0c8244144b2bdf74f37515a9.png[/img]

[b]Smelter[/b]
The Smelter is, of course, a furnace that melts things into other things. It can be used further down the production line. For example, the Smelter can make [b]Iron Rods[/b] out of [b]Iron Ore[/b] or [b]Copper Plate[/b] out of [b]Copper Ore[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8eb33f01a16b3d7bea6bdf5fa1ed72c1d4195da6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1b8f8aad9147a4622a2997aca70050389714a9eb.png[/img]

[b]Fabricator[/b]
This station will produce technological materials and parts that can be used in construction or building technology. It can produce items such as [b]Bolts[/b], [b]Wooden Planks[/b], [b]Wire[/b], etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/0b76d2927954980bd044ba4c4891de4e90a6e87d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8fc567cd32c09b6a3b06498beda7deae243e8a15.png[/img]

[b]Assembler[/b]
Manufacture complete technologies using our Assembler! Here you’ll be able to produce [b]Scooters[/b] or make [b]Water Sprinklers[/b] that can be used for watering automatization on your farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d2119bcd42f5d78aaf77e3092445af598a797c2a.png[/img]

[b]Cooker[/b]
It cooks! Add farm products, select a recipe, and our Cooker will do the rest! Produce delicious dishes that can feed the entire island (and keep their taste buds happy).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8062be63c5140ce8068f9d9257d7ed38dcc48618.png[/img]

[b]Examples of Recipes/Dishes:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cef65ed8f56c010bc167e99c9e80ed641988766e.jpg[/img]

[b]Sewing Station[/b]
Everyone needs pants and you can satisfy the demand by building Sewing Stations that will stitch them together. Pants = profit. Sweaters, shirts, blankets, and other cozy products can be produced with this machinery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/0f998ada73c391ff5c88864316360af6f80f3ad4.png[/img]

[h1]Hydraulic Transportation Rails[/h1]

All Stations can be connected with one other via Hydraulic Transportation Rails (HTR). These rails transport goods from one place to another, similar to conveyer belts. 

These rails can be merged and connected at almost any point to give you flexible access to the goods delivery system. This system will utilize our custom pathfinding algorithm that will allow merging multiple rails together and separation later on. This ease of directionality will allow for a simple delivery of resources either directly to the station or to storage containers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/50e0f34bb7c3085604be545cdac8f11fc0ccfe7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/cc5415866d2b4c294ae3c5b06c15d041d87a3442.png[/img]

[b]Crafting Table[/b]
Will allow you to craft useful materials manually. It doesn’t require electricity to function and can be used at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/348e6f3ad16ef223de29a97d118055ab9794b258.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8d70d45b8d68e21210a11d6af82c6bf8675c3d92.jpg[/img]
[i]Note: inventory icons are placeholders.[/i]

[b]Plant Breeding Table[/b]
Here you’ll be able to breed plants! You can even mix species to create something very unusual. We will talk about this station more in the future as the game design and concepts are still pending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/0acd79a17bf34f0ea5c7277abdcf8672aa76b9ae.png[/img]

We want to have only green, self-sustained energy in the game. Everything that you produce on the farm is harmless to the environment and the life around you. You won't see dark plumes of smoke coming out of machines during production and animals won't suffer. We produce meat and other animal products utilizing our organic [b]3D Printer Station[/b]. It scans animal DNA and prints products related to the animal. Peace, love, and harmony are going to dominate your farm. 💛

With that said, all of your stations need to be powered by electricity. There are a few options for how you can generate electricity in [i]Farm Folks[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e4a58cea71cdf22b2c0df5fbdfddc44dfd17b83a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/121be028c5c690a78993c5633c12ef518c53c4b2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/82e07c5fd0bb75f43cb053daad96381f83e65086.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/bd938e101cb5635f98d986d64110dea8ae3489c8.png[/img]

Energy can be delivered to machines via [b]Electric Poles[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2e31e79f758a2642c6f1ec9a3bd499ba06b7f7d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4ddf02f6d41aa47a9ff2d2eb2611a903a5f29d97.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f8ea4aa1ef1c5beb5fe11b37ce71311d8e40fa4d.png[/img]

You can build [b]Wind Turbines[/b] or [b]Solar Panels[/b] to generate electricity which can then be stored in large [b]Battery Banks[/b] or small mobile ones. Small batteries can be used to power some of your mobile farm machinery like your [b]Electric Scooter[/b] or [b]Motorollers[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/182e997630f8cb34a2bb22e8b7110e217ca09fb8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6daec4a3a49fa653ff18f159ffd34d33a4a72e24.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f8ec07f376d01a4e890783908f06260eef1b8750.png[/img]

[h1]Scooters[/h1]

You can own your very own electric scooter! How cool is that? You know what’s cooler though? You can actually have your friend or an NPC ride with you! You can purchase a Scooter in Town on the Main Island. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/00b1ec8ff6d2c3a7546932a88e6dc928461ae103.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/59d5e9c9517fe07960faeee2ced71e0aa77d2114.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/85bd374131da50840eec7e0ad117867790f1efbb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b28c344e9be1bdde30904fbdfb044ac78f9104d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/eb145e552553b412d5201071e1c263eb8cdb7fad.png[/img]

[h1]Animals[/h1]
On your farm, you’re not only going to plant crops and build beautiful structures, but you'll also be able to tame animals, breed them, and produce animal products for local Islands and NPCs.

We’ve been hard at work modeling, rigging, and animating our animal friends. You’ll be able to make nearly all animals your pets. Your pets can travel with you around the world or - even better - you’ll be able to ride them. Check out the animals we've already modeled:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d3fe3b61057b4028d0459eabf8cd0e3312f78c2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d8e9f815caec7cc82f832fe7c0f2b8f5ce11a268.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/822853aa510f6be30501058a7f84b49b16cd7e75.png[/img]

All animals can be found and tamed in the world or purchased from local NPCs. Animals will have color variations and rarity. You’ll be able to breed them to yield unique color variants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5da04414f2eef4f410e2e60b45dab93c762309f7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/de4935146fb275cafd145188f3785e01ea56b220.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/493bb68bcf696930d020482f096ac73384a5a1e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5871b61bd563d233b3ca953a65d8a4321b186edd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/bd2828e349495d394bc0739f561ef51277bf984b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/36bdb62fcc6c7bcdb3db53eb39c2eaec3e2977bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/43cf4bed2fd652a8d58044cae79b226acbcbbc8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d9c6cfabbc9ad818e2785555116f6b145cb32c1d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/eae6d21e51b2d2e8334abd9c9ae8c7a9c42e7a24.png[/img]

[h1]Animations[/h1]
It all comes in stages. First and foremost, we have to develop a concept for our Characters or Animals before our artists make it into a 3D piece of art. Once we have a 3D model, it is then rigged and animated. So far, we have created over [b]100 unique animations[/b] for our characters and animals. Check out some of these models below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7ef3e51062757869ab874103be2bf03c894e74b6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c558a981327b8b74fbd2c08cac42a48d8bfdebd6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/44cac26b38956fd9c09982fd238b51893336bc48.gif[/img]

[h1]New Crops[/h1]
We will talk more about farming systems in our upcoming updates but we can tell you that we plan to have an excessive amount of crops in the game. Crop growth will have a dynamic link between environmental conditions and moisture. Each plant can produce a different amount of goods and yield a specific harvest based on its treatment during its growth period.

[b]VERY IMPORTANT:[/b] please let us know in the comments if you've come across a crop planting system in the past that you really love. We would love to hear your thoughts! Also, join our Discord for further discussions [url=https://discord.com/invite/FarmFolks]here[/url].

[h3]Carrots[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/74f88ce584bbbee8d33e76c0c632ba84b8daf657.png[/img]

[h3]Potatoes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fd44d136b939e766eceae44a6747122c9033024a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/68cd902ef557caa1608f8583633cb981be82d8e2.png[/img]

[h3]Tomatoes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/79ec9e0cc49ec291f26e35627ed82ff56bcf0aa6.png[/img]

[h3]Eggplants[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/7fbecbc6570911f6de770d806693a3494c02db75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/19b5be2bb8ae08f67500cdb7b3fedafc535b7981.png[/img]

[h3]Corn[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/146c3193f3debc906397897331ee4f09bcca8469.png[/img]

[h3]Cucumbers[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/3585f3e66a6788b673883335a1f0877630de3189.png[/img]

We’re also exploring the possibility of crop cross breeding which would allow you to mix crops together to get a very unique breed. For example, you can mix a Potato with a Watermelon and yield a Watertato.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/05d278dd3c4e3b580c50fa7f47dcdaf9e6e4ebc1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a53c1e59ae4aa46f52e27bf6e09fa3ce469e7293.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c59c0c1c476f812ceb5e3ff4dc5549dfef7031b6.png[/img]

These kinds of crops will have a higher value and will also require more attention from you during its growth period. We will cover more about this system in the future so make sure to sign-up to our email updates if you don’t want to miss it.

[h1]Inventory[/h1]
Oof, this one is a challenge for sure. You know how you play games and never question how certain systems work if they work well? Sometimes, these systems look simple and straightforward but they are actually very complicated! A character's inventory is one of those systems. It’s one thing to make this system work for a single-player experience and another for co-op games. For co-op games, we need to ensure the system is synced with the current world you’re in. We're working tirelessly on this system and we think it’s shaping up nicely. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/df2f17161a801bcb3a60b2130a6b394e8d5bbc01.jpg[/img]
[i]Note: inventory icons are placeholders.[/i]

[h1]Plowing, Seeding and Watering[/h1]
We’re working on the implementation of our [b]Water Spray Gun[/b] which you can carry with you everywhere! In your inventory, you can store water bottles that you can craft at the crafting bench. These bottles can be refilled with water at water ponds. You can also share water bottles with each other in co-op mode. 

Additionally, our faming system is shaping up nicely! As you can see below, planting seeds is going to be extremely satisfying with our advanced watering system. By keeping your plants watered and happy, you'll be the prized farmer on the Island in no time!

notes.title: Character Customizations and NPCs and Towns in the Farm Folks
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Farm Folks![/h1]

We hope you’re happily preparing for the winter holidays! Our team, as usual, has been hard at work with Farm Folks and making it a game you all will love. As we’re sure you’ve noticed, we haven’t posted Dev Updates in a while. We enjoy sharing our work with you as we go along, but we also recognize that it’s nice to have everything compiled into one place. Since we’ve been working nonstop, there’s plenty to discuss! In fact, there’s so much to cover that we’re splitting this Update #5 into three parts.

As voted by our fantastic community, Part 1 below features character customization, NPCs, animations, questlines, and the Town! 

For those of you who are new to Farm Folks, feel free to follow our development more closely by [url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks]joining our Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/farmfolksgame]following us on Twitter[/url]. We post updates on a near-daily basis.

Oh, and if you’re interested in what we’re doing and don’t want to miss our future Devlogs (or even our closed Alpha invites) [url=https://www.farmfolksgame.com/]make sure to sign-up to our emailing list.[/url]

[h1]Character Customization Sets[/h1]
Over the last few months, our talented character modelers have been developing character customizations and NPCs. Each piece of clothing can be substituted for another one from different sets. You’ll be able to unlock new clothing pieces by purchasing them in the local store of the Town or by receiving them as a gift from an NPC or other players in Co-op. 

[previewyoutube=xC4VyoFCTWc;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1b64680484fefc965d9d362f03b4d8790f8cf0ee.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d6e6ac9289284b32410cf33d405ddc5245f4d325.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c9a606099730bc1c33af17a991fa6ee33145179c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1ed9cd535b8feb9b61d3b93b89fac65ae1b099bd.gif[/img]

All of these clothing options need to be adjusted and rigged to support feminine and masculine body types and various animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/287029d9906aafa6d0cfffb302a2f063740e4183.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/29cde455172c954be4c7c8270299d8c86d98b728.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4d5eb6c26262e7c8519d2c9d5c2bb4d5231bd6d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a7d3a607f466b7345ad004d7b8fefa257103f821.jpg[/img]

[h1]Animations[/h1]

Our goal is to provide a rich and immersive experience for you when you play Farm Folks. Because you’ll be able to do many things in this world, we have to ensure that there are a variety of unique animations to support your actions appropriately. Every possible character movement (including our animals) requires specific Rigging and Animation. Our incredibly talented animator, Julya, has been busy bringing all of our characters to life. Check out some of the animations below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/89430047fae1183d49931ce263a177e6532a667c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/8e776debc5c68a794228ba061e67bd9d7013b918.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1806e3b53090c056d77541d211fe36a8ec2a2d5a.gif[/img]

You can track animations that we're adding to the game [url=https://sketchfab.com/crytivo/models]here[/url].

[h1]Masculine Rig and Animations[/h1]

Last month, we specifically worked on masculine body animations. In order to achieve this, we had to adjust all of our current feminine animations and affix them onto a new body! We’re pretty happy with the end result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e333aa7b45904987b4cd6c780e4575fb8ad5549f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/04ea665ac3291ef9088168b27fd1862b94692644.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5d54ccab446b671dfc334c5df4bf4bc00fdfbbb5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/24ce2af1262b3b269764fdd957540a8ed693c380.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/bffa48c1ddb9ceb43b80471f0347184c29872398.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/42ac274e621d5568854aa4a16260d78378256bcd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2233757d7d1487502edeb001a9d31998703ba5a2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/fd88082d6eccb98437f4b9bbc97bf05bcafa42b7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e825557b352398b1802a6d3fb0f5a77b949addca.gif[/img]

[h1]Quest System[/h1]

Every NPC will have their own story for you to uncover. NPCs will also have a set of things they like and dislike.

NPCs will not only have storylines, but also random quests ranging from bringing some homegrown carrots to your friend to researching a particular technology for an NPC. The majority of random quests will be unique. Some quests will analyze player actions and, of course, all quests will give you precious rewards - resources, relations, special items, and even unique clothes and transport. 

Here is a current list of Quest Types we’re planning to add:
[list]
[*] Craft specific items (and keep them, but also get additional rewards)
[*] Bring specific items to NPC
[*] Grow X plants of Y type
[*] Catch X fish of Y type
[*] Research specific technology 
[*] Explore some places on island and discover treasure
[*] Construct specific buildings/furniture in your house (if it’s accessible for you)
[*] Other types
[/list]

Most of these quests will have varying difficulties, allowing you to select harder (or easier) quest versions. Harder quests will yield greater rewards that would otherwise be inaccessible with quests of an easier difficulty. 
The game will also track your progress and balance tasks so you can be well-informed about the odds of quest completion. A quest giver won’t overwhelm a newcomer with a quest to bring him thousands of advanced microprocessors or 20 tonnes of refined titanium alloys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5db5db3a18183f4541870a8080f59fefa909fa3f.jpg[/img]

Each NPC will be prone to give quests associated with them. For example:
[list]
[*] Fishermen will give quests related to fishing such as bringing him fish, fishing tools, or components needed for a new boat, fishing rod, etc.
[*] A tailor will usually request some cloth, wool, or clothing that’s already sewn
[*] Town folks may request items ranging from bricks and carrots to advanced electronics and car wheels
[/list]

[h1]Romances[/h1]
We’re proud to say that every NPC in Farm Folks is romanceable! We’re designing romantic events that you can attend with your chosen one. Some examples of romantic activities include, but are not limited to: Skydiving, sharing Cocktails, hosting Yacht Parties, Jet Skiing, Romantic Dinners, etc. 

Some NPCs, if you take the time to get to know them, will share their dreams with you. We will talk more about NPC behaviors and romance in the future, so be sure you’re [url=https://www.farmfolksgame.com/]signed up for our email updates[/url] so you don’t miss it!

[h1]NPCs[/h1]
In a previous update, we introduced Pietro, our wholesome trader and traveler. He owns his own trade boat that he inherited from his father. Now, we have a 3D model of Pietro and his beloved trade boat, Giuseppe’s Son.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a7f2aa93751c5cca2c2bda8f50c142508b92d3c8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/efbbe41ea6c9c0c399ac7fd8ed0341097d7f8848.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/3c1a7a1628ea97896ddaaee566a57f9672668838.png[/img]

[h1]NPCs Schedules and Behaviors[/h1]

NPCs will live their own lives and stick to their personal daily schedules. Some NPCs will have to attend work and can be met either at their place of employment or at their homes at certain times of the day. NPCs can change their haircut or outfit which will be reflected in your conversation with them. If you hint that you aren’t a big fan of their new look, they may revert their changes to how they originally looked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/c16d9204869b1af880fd76b51def9593cddfd4d4.jpg[/img]

[h1]NPCs Noticing Your Appearance[/h1]

NPCs will notice your presence and will greet you or comment on some of your behaviors. They may, in fact, compliment a fresh haircut or your clothing style. Some places in Town will have a dress code if you would like to attend them. For example, a Cocktail Party on a Yacht will require you to find a Cocktail Dress or Tuxedo before you can attend. And, of course, you can invite Anjelica to join you since she’s always dreamed of attending such a party. She may even need help in acquiring a dress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f9f865d9e0c0939a48df79e487437af2e1f11b51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6405950c788cf76bf8cee4fc751e065007c26fd6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Concepts of New NPCs[/h1]

[h1]Meet Anjelica! [/h1]

Anjelica is a skilled engineer responsible for maintaining local structure and keeping everything together. Most of the time she can be found working with her colleague, Nico.

When Anjelica manages to pull herself away from work, her world quiets just enough to find herself reminiscing about her trip to the Island of the Dragons. During her time there, Anjelica foolishly fell in love with a beautiful mermaid that lived in the area. Anjelica hasn’t been back since, but dreams of meeting her mermaid again. Perhaps you’re the one to help reunite them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5575088b1b1daba6b06a9f4d496660d15def9c7a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/4df08a20c69599b75b6c4a4c054edfe923b0f009.jpg[/img]

[h1]Nico[/h1]

Nico is always on the lookout for ways to improve his technological skills. In helping Anjelica with engineering work, he doesn’t mind stepping away for a moment or two to help you fix something. He also has a side hustle of selling homemade gadgets out of his garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/518f04ab933365c68780162a680172bb1fc7327c.png[/img]

[h1]Introducing Stella! [/h1]

Stella is the charming and charismatic florist of the Town. You can always count on her to brighten your day, whether that’s from the sunflowers or her own smile. As a big fan of exotic flowers, Stella has an incredible green thumb. Visit her shop to admire new and familiar plants and flowers that you yourself can learn to grow on your farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/68ad8d26b62e42e9baf38e2e0754f22c212a456c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/26a8990236c7ca303fb2e3f20858dc78271f2989.png[/img]

Need some help with your plantings? Stella may also share some secrets on how to increase the health and yield of your flowers and crops. Get to know her better and you may even discover what this florist’s favorite flower is.  

[h1]Katarina[/h1]

Katarina works at the largest souvenir shop on the island. As a timid individual, you may find Katarina hiding behind some of the items in-store, but that doesn’t mean she’s not willing to lend you a helping hand. Ask Katarina for help in picking out some special decorations for friends or for your own home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/be665b08c9df617d9d995fc9b519e1b67750d480.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/5ce818d438c763fbee21c5a5f29d957480714cbd.png[/img]

One of Katarina’s favorite hobbies include bird watching! She hopes she can once again see the strange bird she discovered in the Fairy Forest.

[h1]Rebeca[/h1]

Rebeca is a salesperson at the local scooter shop on the Island. Rebeca has a spunky personality and avoids being placed in one box. Be it her hair, clothing style, or interests, Rebeca is always willing to try new things and lead a life of adventure. Need an electric scooter? Visit Rebeca in Town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/e8b18fd101cd9a648777d6914497b68ccbc0df1d.png[/img]

[h1]Say hello to Aurora! [/h1]

Aurora is a talented landscape architect with a love for nature and an eye for design. She strives to create yards and gardens that can act as safe and serene places for people, especially when they need help in turning their vision into reality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/42b667dc4e74176d6b6838743e7fdfdad2303451.png[/img]

Aurora will be happy to help you with your landscaping needs and can even provide you access to unique gardening accessories and decorations. As a lover of sunsets and boating adventures, Aurora is a kind-hearted soul you won’t soon forget.

[b]Our NPC system is still in the early stages of development which means, if you have any recommendations or suggestions, now is the time to share them with us! Leave us a comment about what NPC catches your eye or what else you would like to see implemented in the game.[/b]

[h1]Islands and Town[/h1]

The Town and islands of Farm Folks are inspired by the archipelagos and islands of Sicily. The old, Italian-inspired structures of Town are going to become the heart of the game as you will need to visit them frequently to advance your stories. In Town, you will be able to meet new NPCs who will have their own character traits, stories, and preferences.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/724d8aa12c40a315bc5585edcbabe4c8c7955be4.png[/img]

Here are some of the beautiful coastal cities that our amazing artists used as inspiration for the Town.
Inspired by the archipelagos and islands of Sicily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/11bfe8617b384d029e3812c2d498892ef17083ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b04bc1a23becdd07bc936d036c7b52bccd246f9a.jpg[/img]

You will also be able to buy customizable items/options from local shops. These items can include: a new T-shirt, pants, backpack, electric scooter, or even cosmetic options like haircuts, tattoos, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/bda91e4828654095dd7ad0235ef513cfe0acf747.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/0275d2122082b7308ecc9749a892857a9570e87b.png[/img]

We’re designing the world of Farm Folks to support future expansions. For the future, we’re planning to have multiple islands that host a variety of towns and scattered points of interest. You’ll be able to use various transportation like boats, jet skis, scooters, or speed trains that connect islands together to visit these new and wondrous places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6915c29b83a7895cf97bf5f9f8e650aee8082b17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/a167220b72cd905005004ad20b4fef2eaadade01.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/14a216447b6e161cc5457de670eefd87b60bd2ba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d751f2a78204a6f90a973f99684a6f262fd46881.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/97174b007c8a95d62ee71329c63b8630751e2a4f.png[/img]

[h1]OH! We Have Mermaids![/h1]

The world of Farm Folks will be filled with all sorts of mysteries and wonders to uncover. Since your character will be able to swim and dive, you’ll not only have journeys on land, but also by sea! On your underwater adventures, you may be introduced to some unique creatures, including the Mermaid Colony. You’ll be able to meet the inhabitants of this colony, discover their stories, and yes, even romance them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/eda74da5fb9de6600017a29f6288e8642a27be28.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/f2de983110ac93c56a62032edae7764512b7c0e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/10b2c67cf86357f105f74f4e910059d281ac5b5c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/773641d47777aea4258d5955b0344c06d35e8d14.png[/img]

Some mermaids will have the ability to convert into a more human-like appearance, using their legs (wow) to go on a date or two with you. We will talk more in the future about different kinds of mysterious colonies that inhabit our islands.

If you haven’t already, join our Discord where you can follow our dev updates on a daily basis, provide immediate feedback, and join the conversation with other farm folks!

[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/200b550b6f9b1306789740d615da077f16292ba6.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]If you would like to help us test the game in the future and don’t want to miss an update, make sure to [url=https://www.farmfolksgame.com/]sign-up to email updates here[/url].[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Farm Folks - Devlog #4
notes.content:
[h3]Hello farming engineers![/h3]

We’re excited to share with you our latest development upgrades for Farm Folks!

But - before you continue - you need to make sure you’re part of our awesome Discord community. Click here to join. We love sharing unique development content, engaging with our friends, and are planning to run some exciting contests where you can influence development AND win some amazing prizes. What are you waiting for?

[url=https://discord.gg/farmfolks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/2cc500ef008c04bb0e825a54dade5a760cc05276.png[/img][/url]

[h3]PRE-ALPHA[/h3]

The Pre-Alpha is very close! We're aiming to let qualifying backers play it very, very soon. We will have a separate update sometime next week with more details, including actual dates, who will get access, and what you can expect to see in the game at the current development stage.

[url=https://mailchi.mp/crytivo/farmfolks][b]SIGN-UP TO GET NOTIFIED[/b][/url]

As things are settling down, we’re becoming more and more active on social media and would like to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTQ37eCSqpqDorrcpIQKcNg?sub_confirmation=1]invite you to subscribe to our YouTube channel[/url] to keep an eye on our day-to-day updates. Leave us your likes and comments on new videos. This will help us grow our channel and unlock new YouTube perks which will allow us to share even more content with you. [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTQ37eCSqpqDorrcpIQKcNg?sub_confirmation=1]Subscribe here[/url].

We’re also on TikTok and already have videos with over 100K views, crazy ha! [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@farmfolks]Click here to check it out[/url]

Alright, enough with the social mambo jambo, let’s get to “business.”

[h3]WATCH THE DEVLOG #4 VIDEO SUMMARY[/h3]

[previewyoutube=6TW9XpsrPmo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]IN-GAME LIGHTING AND SEASONS
[/h3]

Farm Folks will have super duper awesome lighting systems that will allow us to have dynamic weather conditions along with breathtaking views - all of which are going to be very different from season to season. Expect very romantic experiences with NPCs like dinners that will take place at the hill cliffs during sunset. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/680cb3d94c90df2b6d85766fba53c0f400943819.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/6a69f10cf68f23885c797b35de418e3c1d1fcfcd.jpg[/img]

[b]Unlike in other farming life sim games, Farm Folks will have a continuous day/night system[/b] that will let you continue managing and/or building your farm - even at night. Your character will have the stamina that will allow them to continue their journey for several days at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/1a8d30d5ba6c52d7856df943e158bcbf07aa96f1.gif[/img]

[previewyoutube=W_O1YkYTrwA;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/19c8bc1aada750c4844d0ea9de10fe480db73b26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/9854654a29187f79180e4cf59e637eae29c0b587.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/044d1efa4c3487dc8697726fb971843ec41f9f79.gif[/img]

Things like wind, rain, or snow can also start dynamically and will have different lengths based on the current season in-game. You’ll be able to check the weather forecast on your laptop or TV. We will talk more about the forecast system in our future updates. Make sure to sign up for our updates so you don’t miss it!

[h3]HAIRSTYLES AND CUSTOMIZATION[/h3]

In Farm Folks, we’re planning to have a great set of various hairstyles to choose from and, of course, you’ll be able to customize the color of the hair. We’re also planning to add a Hair Constructor to the game which will give you absolute freedom over the haircuts you would like your character to wear. You can unlock unique hairstyles in the saloons of the Portorovigo Town located on Softsholl Island. We will talk more about Local Shops in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/d37cf1968431e2afccdd4b1279738e1be4657c23.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226734/b442e54c783d5c036a112734da7bedff6dc53324.jpg[/img]

[h3]REAL-TIME HAIR PHYSICS[/h3]

In addition to beautiful, custom hairstyles, we’re also revising our animations to ensure your hair - and every other character detail - looks soft and organic. We’re adding real-time physics to your character’s hair which means it will bounce and sway based on environmental conditions like wind.

[previewyoutube=2KIK8Artzdo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]FISHING[/h3]

What farming game is without fishing? The waters in Farm Folks are going to be filled with fish and other discoveries. Each fish will have a rarity level, ranging from Common, Rare, and Epic variants. You can cook, trade, or even farm caught fishes. Yeh you read it right, you’ll be able to have your own fish farm!

We just named one of our fishes with the help of our FanClub members.

Legendairy and VIP members can participate in closed community voting where they can come up with original names for items, animals, etc. in the game. If you would like to become a member, check available tiers here

[h3]ISLAND AND CONSTRUCTION[/h3]

For the last few months, we were working on our first island. This initial island is designed to give us maximum information from the closed tests as it has a diverse landscape. Unlike in other farming games, our goal is to give you the ability to build your structures wherever you want - be it on open ground, hills, the beach, or even against mountain cliffs. We will talk about the construction process in our next update.

[h3]NEW NPC IS ON THE WAY[/h3]

[h3]TEAM UPDATES[/h3]

We’re also happy to welcome new members of our dev team! Meet [b]Adam[/b], an insanely talented technical artist, and [b]Bruno and Camila[/b], a husband/wife team working on beautiful concept art and character development.
